summary: On node1, set /etc/security/pwquality.conf minlen=12 and minclass=3 (backed up original first). pam_pwquality was already wired into system-auth/password-auth as 'requisite', so no PAM changes were needed. Validated as the actual target user (not root, which bypasses pwquality) that short and low-complexity passwords are rejected and a 12+ char, 3-class password is accepted. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured healthy baseline (boot_id, config, PAM wiring), issued a non-blocking shutdown -r now, confirmed disconnection then reconnection, proved boot_id changed (e9250ad1... -> 2d4bc72a...) with uptime reset to 0, and re-verified the policy config and functional enforcement post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected OS (RHEL 7.9), libpwquality install, pwquality.conf, and PAM wiring in system-auth/password-auth
Set minlen=12 and minclass=3 in /etc/security/pwquality.conf via sed with fallback append
Verified pam_pwquality.so requisite line already present in system-auth and password-auth

Created disposable test user, verified via sudo -n -u <user> -- passwd (self-service context) that short/2-class passwords are rejected and a 12+ char/3-class password is accepted; cleaned up test user
Captured baseline boot_id/uptime/config/PAM state on node1
Issued sudo -n shutdown -r now in background so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1; confirmed timeout during reboot then successful reconnection
Confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reset, proving an actual restart
Re-verified pwquality.conf and PAM wiring persisted post-restart, and re-ran functional passwd tests as a fresh disposable user confirming enforcement still works

evidence.requirement: Password policy: min 12 chars, at least 3 character classes, enforced for new user passwords
evidence.summary: Initial inspection showed pwquality already wired into PAM. Config updated to minlen=12/minclass=3. Root-initiated passwd tests were misleading (root bypasses pwquality); self-service tests as the target user confirmed rejection of short/2-class passwords (rc=1) and acceptance of a 12-char/3-class password (rc=0).

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence protocol for node1: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id e9250ad1-c4f0-4bec-b58e-4e30255a8dcf, config, and PAM wiring. Issued shutdown -r now (acknowledged before disconnect). Confirmed connection timeout mid-reboot, then reconnection with new boot_id 2d4bc72a-61d3-4e84-b523-e760fa60aa3c and uptime reset to 0, proving an actual restart. Post-restart re-check confirmed pwquality.conf and PAM wiring persisted and functional enforcement (reject short rc=1, accept valid rc=0) still works.
